syllabus.title: Practice Test 01 (Alpha) Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Basic Maths & Calculus (Mathematical Tools)(Complete Chapter)
• Vector(Complete Chapter)
• Units and Measurements: Physical Quantities and Units, Dimensions and Dimensions formula , Dimensional Analysis.

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Some Basic Concept of Chemistry(Complete Chapter)
• Solutions: Solution Binary Solution and Concentration Terms, Solubility and Henry Law Raoult’s law & its application Ideal & non ideal solutions.

📌 BOTANY
• Cell : The unit of life (complete chapter)
• Cell Cycle and Cell Division: Cell Cycle and Cell Division , Phases of the cell cycle , Mitosis

📌 ZOOLOGY
• Structural Organization in Animals: Tissues ,Animal Tissues, Epithelium Tissue , Cell Junctions Connective Tissue , Muscular Tissue, Nervous Tissue, Frog.
